features: Removes the remaining dependency from live-display/feed.php to admin/live-screen/projection.php
Live Display feed now renders directly from the secure display session and scoring database without admin projection authentication
Direct feed supports Judges, Competitors, Scoring, Callbacks, Finalists, Winner Podium and Final Ranking for Real and Test data modes
Projector refresh now keys off a full state fingerprint including screen type, round, page, reveal position and lock state instead of relying only on state_version
Polling interval adjusted to 700ms for responsive remote screen changes
Winner Podium continues to support progressive 5th, 4th, 3rd, 2nd, 1st and Full Podium reveal state
Results Reveal Safety remains enforced before protected result feeds render
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
